title: Visualize calibration evolution in labeling and timeline playback
description: Each classifier card exposes a space-efficient confidence reliability graph alongside Recall, Precision, Accuracy (always that order). Show predicted confidence on x-axis, observed correctness on y-axis, perfect diagonal, bin support and calibration error with uncertainty caveats; distinguish calibrated head from raw decision passthrough. Timeline current position/Next/Previous/Play selects the latest recorded per-classifier snapshot at or before that point, never future snapshots. Curve updates visually as labels and optimizations progress; allow inspection of snapshot/window/head provenance and matched before/after calibration where available. Older history lacking snapshots says unavailable, no synthetic backfill presented as recorded evidence. Use light/dark system styling and accessible graph summary/tooltips. Acceptance: fixture playback crosses multiple cycles and proves curves change at correct events, reverse seeking restores prior curve, classifier filter works and no model calls occur during playback; iPad graph does not steal labeling space.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Playback curve listens to current position snapshots at or before selected event; frontend spec proves forward/back seeking clears future curves. Live cards show source counts, Brier/log loss, matched calibration comparison and optional provenance. Remaining: rendered multiple-cycle browser verification and classifier-filter snapshot scope tests.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Added matched raw decision-model versus final-classifier recall, precision, accuracy and overlaid calibration in labeling cards and playback. Cycle snapshots pin class roles; playback replaces snapshots on reverse seek and reports unavailable older history. Offline UI regression covers clearing future comparison on reverse seek. Remaining: deployed multicycle browser acceptance, classifier filtering, and tablet graph layout.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Added reproducible seed_calibration_playback.py with a separate empty-workspace guard, three real API/worker cycles, two independent classifiers and fake synchronous Jev transport. Two no-network specs verify shared call count, immutable per-cycle calibration counts/ECE/provenance, independent labels and refusal to touch an existing workspace. Browser verified Play updates curves, cycle-three prediction retains two reviewed samples until its metrics event, reverse seeking restores one sample and then unavailable, and Inspect classifier selects the independent Practicality history (final ECE 36.7% vs Relevance 63.3%). No current-page console errors; screenshot var/web/calibration-playback-browser-proof.png. Verification skill guided API/SQLite-to-browser checks. This fixture is UI evidence, not optimization improvement evidence. Actual iPad/dark graph-space acceptance remains open; no real labels or paid model calls changed.
